name: Electronic / Electrical
structure_example: System > Subsystem > Component > Part, e.g. Lighting System > Headlamp > LED Module > LED Driver IC / PCB / Connector / Heat Sink
function_example: Converts electrical energy into a regulated light output within a specified lumen and color-temperature range

failure_chains_starter.fe: Exterior lighting fails during night driving, increasing collision risk
failure_chains_starter.fc: Solder joint on the driver IC cracks under thermal cycling stress
failure_chains_starter.pc: Thermal simulation at design review + solder joint reliability design rules
failure_chains_starter.dc: 1000-hour thermal cycling test + post-test cross-section inspection

failure_chains_starter.fe: Display shows corrupted or frozen image, distracting the driver
failure_chains_starter.fc: Insufficient decoupling capacitance causes voltage droop under peak load
failure_chains_starter.pc: Power integrity simulation at design review
failure_chains_starter.dc: Bench-level load-transient test on prototype boards

failure_chains_starter.fe: Wiring harness connection fails intermittently in service
failure_chains_starter.fm: Connector pin loses contact under vibration
failure_chains_starter.fc: Crimp force out of specification during assembly
failure_chains_starter.pc: Crimp force monitoring with automatic reject on the crimping press
failure_chains_starter.dc: Pull-force test on a sampling basis + first-piece verification

special_characteristics_guidance: Safety-relevant circuits (lighting, braking-adjacent sensors, airbag interfaces) are the most common source of S=9-10 chains in this domain — expect CC flags there. EMC/regulatory compliance failures are a common source of S=9.
